title: An Ostrich Can Kill a Lion With One Kick (and Run at 43 mph)

scenes.text: An ostrich can kill a lion with one kick.
Nine feet tall, 300 pounds. Each foot has two toes, and the big one ends in a claw that cuts deep.
When cornered, it kicks forward with the force to kill lions and other big predators.
And it doesn't usually need to. It sprints at 43 miles an hour, with strides over ten feet long.
The biggest bird on Earth, and the fastest on land.
Nine feet, 43 miles an hour, a kick that kills lions.

description:
An ostrich stands up to 9 feet tall, weighs around 300 pounds, and when cornered can deliver forward kicks powerful enough to kill lions and other large predators. Its main toe ends in a claw that can cut deeply.
It usually doesn't need to fight: the largest bird on Earth is also the fastest on land, sprinting at up to 43 miles an hour with strides of more than 10 feet.
Which bird would you least like to annoy? Comment below.
first_comment: An ostrich egg weighs about three pounds, the same as two dozen chicken eggs. Would you rather race an ostrich or arm wrestle a kangaroo?
